identification: Donald Friend (1915-1989), three standing nude Balinese youths, pen and ink with watercolour/gouache washes (ochre, grey, white) on paper, in a gilt frame with double mat, 73 x 48 cm per catalogue. Inscribed lower right in the artist's usual three-line form: '3 Nudes, / Donald Friend / Bali'. Typical of his 1970s Bali figure studies (hatched ink line over loose wash). Looks original hand-drawn work, not a print: wash bleeds and pen pressure visible in close-up.
